DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所と電話番号の変更をご希望ですね。どなたの登録についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to change your address and telephone number, correct? Whose registered details would you like to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まず私自身の口座です。家族も同じ新住所なので、私が変更すれば家族名義の口座の通知も全部こちらへ来ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人住所変更で同居転居家族名義通知も全て新住所になると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: First, the details for my own account. My family is moving to the same new address, so I thought that changing my details would mean all notices for accounts in their names would come to this address too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought changing your address would also redirect all notices for accounts in the names of family members moving with you to the same new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名義が違う方の登録は、お客様の変更と同じ手続きで済むとは案内できません。今日はご自身の確認書類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot tell you that changes to details registered under other people's names can be completed through your own change procedure. Have you brought your own identification documents today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の新住所がわかる書類を持っています。家族分を私の申込みに含めず、家族本人が何を相談するかは別に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人新住所資料を示し家族分を含めず家族本人の相談は別に尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a document showing my new address. I do not want to include my family's accounts in my application. I would like to ask separately what my family members should inquire about themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the document with your new address. Say in Japanese that you will not include your family's accounts and would like to ask separately about inquiries they should make themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人分と家族分を分けます。電話番号の変更についても、お客様が連絡を受けられる番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will keep your changes separate from your family's. For the telephone number change, we will also check which number we can reach you at.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらが新しい自分の番号です。家族の番号を自分の番号として書くつもりではありません。住所と電話の両方が変更対象か、見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人新番号を示し家族番号を本人用とせず住所電話両対象を見直すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is my new number. I am not planning to enter a family member's number as my own. Please check again that both my address and telephone number are included in the changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your new telephone number. Say in Japanese that you will not use a family member's number as your own, and ask for a check that both your address and telephone number are to be changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更対象を整理し、本人確認と申込方法について担当へおつなぎします。送付先へ反映される時期も説明を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will clarify which details need changing and refer you to the staff responsible for identity checks and the application procedure. Please also confirm their explanation of when the change will be reflected in the mailing address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日申し出たから、準備済みの通知まで必ず新住所へ届くとは思いません。反映前後の通知をどこまで確認できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本日申出で準備済通知も必ず新住所とせず反映前後の確認範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not assume that making the request today guarantees even notices already prepared for dispatch will reach my new address. I would like to ask what can be checked about notices sent before and after the change takes effect.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that requesting the change today does not guarantee that notices already prepared will go to the new address. Ask what can be checked about notices before and after the change takes effect.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲を担当からお伝えします。家族の通知についても、家族本人への案内を別に聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain what can be checked. For notices addressed to your family, please ask separately what guidance your family members should receive themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の住所と電話の変更だけを確認し、家族には「あなたの分も済んだ」とは伝えません。申込前に入力を読み返し、通知先と反映の説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人住所電話のみ確認し家族分完了と伝えず入力と通知反映説明を申込前に確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check only the changes to my own address and telephone number, and I will not tell my family that their changes are complete too. Before submitting the application, I will reread the entries and listen to the explanation of the mailing address and when the change takes effect.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check only your own address and telephone number changes and will not tell your family their changes are complete. Explain that before applying, you will check the entries and the explanation of where notices will be sent and when the change takes effect.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではご本人分の確認から承ります。変更完了や家族名義の変更はまだ確定していません。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will start by checking your own details. Neither completion of your changes nor changes to accounts in your family members' names have been confirmed yet. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお菓子の表示について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about the information on this snack's label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ナッツのアレルギーがあります。原材料の一覧に見当たらないと思ったのですが、その下に同じ工場についての文章があり、読み切れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ナッツアレルギーで原材料に見当たらないが同工場注意文を読めていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a nut allergy. I thought I could not see nuts in the ingredients list, but there is a statement about the same factory below it, and I have not managed to read all of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a nut allergy, cannot see nuts in the ingredients list, but have not fully read the warning about the same factory.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原材料の一覧と、この注意書きは分けて読みましょう。下段には、同じ工場でナッツを含む製品を製造するという文面があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's read the ingredients list separately from this warning. The text below says that products containing nuts are manufactured in the same factory.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一覧に見当たらないだけで食べられるとは決めません。注意書きはナッツが必ず入っているという断定とも違うので、私から安全だとも危険度が低いとも判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一覧に見当たらないだけで可とせず工場文を必ず含有とも断定せず安全や低危険と自己判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not decide that I can eat it just because I cannot see nuts listed. The warning also does not state that the product definitely contains nuts, so I cannot decide for myself that it is safe or low risk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume the product is suitable just because nuts are absent from the list, or that the factory warning means it definitely contains nuts. Explain that you will not judge it safe or low risk yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私からもお客様が食べられるとは保証できません。不明点を問い合わせる場合は、商品名と製造者の連絡先の表示を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I cannot guarantee that you can eat it either. If you want to ask about anything unclear, we can check the product name and the manufacturer's contact details on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は買わず、問い合わせに必要な商品名と注意書きを控えます。少し食べて確かめる方法は取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は買わず商品名と注意文を控え試食で確認しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not buy it today. I will note the product name and the warning so I can ask about them. I will not try eating a little to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not buy it today, will note the product name and warning for an inquiry, and will not test it by tasting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示を控えてご検討ください。保存の欄も、未開封と開封後の説明が分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please make a note of the label information and consider it. The storage section also gives separate instructions for before and after opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 問い合わせのときに混ぜないよう、原材料、工場の注意、保存方法を別々に控えたいです。期限の日付がどの保存状態の案内かも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原材料工場注意保存を別記し期限の保存状態条件も読みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to record the ingredients, factory warning and storage instructions separately so I do not mix them up when I ask. I will also check which storage conditions the date on the label applies to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to record the ingredients, factory warning and storage instructions separately, and also read which storage conditions apply to the date on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この商品の期限と保存条件を合わせてご確認ください。開封後も同じ期限までよいと、一部の表示だけで決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check this product's date together with its storage conditions. Do not decide from just part of the label that it can be kept until the same date after opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未開封の条件を開封後へそのまま広げず、表示をまとめます。製造者へ不明点を聞いた上で、自分の条件に合う商品を改めて検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封条件を開封後へ広げず表示整理し製造者照会後に再検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will organize the label information without assuming that the conditions for an unopened product also apply after opening. After asking the manufacturer about anything unclear, I will reconsider which product meets my needs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not apply unopened-product conditions after opening. Explain that you will organize the label information, ask the manufacturer about anything unclear, and then reconsider your choice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は購入せず表示の確認までで承りました。控えた内容を問い合わせにお使いください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Today you are only checking the label, without buying the product. Please use your notes when making your inquiry. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園の歩き方について、ご希望を伺います。どのように過ごしたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask what you would like from your walk in the park? How would you like to spend your time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 短く歩いて静かに座りたいです。でも、近くの広場から音が聞こえるので、広場を通る一周の道以外も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 短く歩き静かに休みたいが広場の音があり一周以外の道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a short walk and then to sit somewhere quiet. But I can hear noise from the nearby plaza, so I would also like to know about routes other than the circuit through the plaza.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want a short walk and a quiet rest, but can hear noise from the plaza. Ask about routes other than the circuit through it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は広場で催しの案内があります。樹木沿いを短く往復する案もありますが、そこなら音が聞こえないとは保証できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an event announced for the plaza today. One option is a short walk out and back along the trees, but we cannot guarantee that you will not hear the noise there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 必ず静かな場所を探して遠くまで行くのではなく、近い道で様子を見ます。途中に座れる場所があるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必ず静かな所を遠くまで探さず近い道で様子を見て途中座席を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Rather than going a long way in search of somewhere guaranteed to be quiet, I will see what a nearby path is like. Please also tell me whether there is somewhere to sit along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will try a nearby path instead of going far to find guaranteed quiet. Ask whether there is somewhere to sit along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 樹木沿いの道の手前にベンチの印があります。催しの区域を横切る近道ではなく、こちらの道から確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a bench marked just before the path along the trees. You can check it by taking this path, rather than a shortcut across the event area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 催しの間を抜けず、教わった道でベンチの所までにします。足元に段差があるか、図だけでなく現地でも見てから進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 催しを横断せず樹木沿いベンチまでとし段差は現地で確認して進みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not cut through the event. I will follow the route you showed me and go only as far as the bench. Before going ahead, I would like to check for steps or changes in level on site as well as on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will avoid crossing the event area and go only as far as the bench by the trees. Explain that you want to check for changes in level on site before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現地の表示と路面を確かめてください。ベンチが使えないときは、入口側へ戻る案もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the signs and the path surface when you get there. If you cannot use the bench, another option is to return toward the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座れなければ次の席を探して長く歩きません。音や疲れが気になったら戻りたいので、今の入口へ戻る目印を紙に示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空席なしで次席探しを長く続けず音疲労時に戻れる入口目印を紙へ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I cannot sit down, I will not keep walking a long way looking for another seat. I would like to return if the noise or tiredness bothers me, so please mark a landmark on the paper to help me get back to this entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not keep walking a long way looking for another seat if none is available. Ask for a landmark on paper to help you return to this entrance if noise or fatigue bothers you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口側の案内板を目印に記しました。途中で催しの別の出口へ出てしまわないよう、戻る側の表示を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have marked the information board near the entrance as a landmark. Please check the signs for the way back so you do not accidentally leave through a different exit for the event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板へ戻る短い往復にします。座席や静けさが合わなければ、予定を延ばさず入口へ戻り、今日は散歩を終えることも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内板へ短往復し座席静けさが合わなければ延長せず入口へ戻り終了も考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take a short walk out and back, returning to the information board. If the seating or noise level does not suit me, I will not extend the walk. I will return to the entrance and may end today's walk there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take a short walk out and back to the information board. Explain that if the seating or quiet is unsuitable, you will return to the entrance without extending the walk and consider ending it for today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの紙をお持ちください。催しの区域を避け、体調と周りの様子に合わせてお過ごしください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this paper with you. Avoid the event area and adjust your plans to how you feel and the conditions around you. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大きなお荷物ですね。ご利用の便が分かるものをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: That is a large piece of luggage. Do you have something showing which service you are taking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この予約票のバスに乗ります。スーツケースが重いので、階段を通らない行き方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約票の便を示し、重いスーツケースのため階段を避ける経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am taking the bus shown on this reservation slip. My suitcase is heavy, so please tell me how to get there without using stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the service on your reservation slip and ask in Japanese for a route avoiding stairs because your suitcase is heavy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの便は二階の四番乗り場です。右のエレベーターが使えますが、今は少し列ができています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That service departs from bay four on the second floor. You can use the elevator on the right, but there is a short queue at the moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出発まで二十分あります。エレベーターを待っても、乗り場へ間に合いそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出発まで二十分と伝え、エレベーター待ちを含めて間に合うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are twenty minutes until departure. Do you think I can reach the bay in time, including the wait for the elevator?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that departure is in twenty minutes and ask whether you can reach the bay in time, including the elevator wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 普段なら移動に五分ほどですが、待ち時間は読めません。列の係員に出発時刻を伝えていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The journey usually takes about five minutes, but we cannot predict the waiting time. You can tell the attendant at the queue what time your bus departs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に係員に声をかけます。荷物を横に置いて待てる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 係員に時刻を伝えると決め、荷物を横に置ける待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will speak to the attendant first. Is there somewhere I can wait with my luggage beside me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell the attendant your departure time, and ask for a waiting place where you can put your luggage beside you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列の入口横に待機場所があります。ご家族はいらっしゃいますか。一緒に並ばれると案内しやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a waiting area beside the entrance to the queue. Do you have family with you? It is easier to guide you if you queue together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 母はあちらの椅子に座っています。母も歩くのが遅いので、二人で待機場所へ移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 椅子にいる母は歩くのが遅いと伝え、二人で待機場所へ移ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My mother is sitting on that chair. She also walks slowly, so the two of us will move to the waiting area together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your mother is sitting on the chair and walks slowly, and explain that you will both move to the waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人ですね。乗り場までの介助が必要でしたら、係員にご相談ください。私からも状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are two of you, then. If you need assistance getting to the bay, please ask the attendant. I will also explain your situation to them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物を運ぶのは自分でできますが、母の歩く速さに合わせて乗り場まで案内していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物は自分で運べると伝え、母の歩く速さに合わせた乗り場案内を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can carry the luggage myself, but I would like someone to guide us to the bay at my mother's walking pace.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can carry the luggage yourself, but ask to be guided to the bay at your mother's walking pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望を係員に伝えます。まずお母様と待機場所でお待ちください。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that request on to the attendant. First, please wait with your mother in the waiting area. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談ですね。新しい住所を書いたものはお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about registering your move here, correct? Have you brought anything with your new address written on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸契約書を持ってきましたが、部屋番号の欄が空白です。申請書には何と書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約書に部屋番号がないと伝え、申請書への書き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought my rental agreement, but the room-number field is blank. What should I write on the application form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the rental agreement has no room number, and ask what to write on the application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 推測で埋めずに、正しい番号を確認しましょう。大家さんなどに連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's confirm the correct number instead of filling it in by guesswork. Can you contact your landlord or someone who knows?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大家さんには今、電話できます。住所の表記も一緒に確認してから書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大家に今電話できると答え、住所表記も確認してから記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can call the landlord now. I would like to check how the address should be written as well, before I fill it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can call the landlord now and will check how to write the address before filling in the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できるまで、この欄は空けておきましょう。ほかにお持ちの書類を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's leave this field blank until it is confirmed. Could you show me the other documents you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前の自治体でもらった書類と在留カードです。会社から預かった封筒もありますが、開けてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手持ちの二つの書類を示し、会社の封筒を開けてよいか分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: These are the document I received from my previous municipality and my residence card. I also have an envelope my company gave me, but I do not know whether I am allowed to open it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the two documents you have brought. Say in Japanese that you do not know whether you may open the envelope from your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封筒は勝手に開けず、提出先と内容を会社に確認してください。今回はご本人だけのお引っ越しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not open the envelope without checking. Ask your company where it is to be submitted and what it contains. Are you the only person moving this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私一人です。会社の保険に入っているので、保険について別の手続きがあるかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単身の転入と会社の保険加入を伝え、別途の保険手続きの確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, just me. I am enrolled in my company's insurance, so I would also like to check whether I need any separate insurance procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are moving alone and are enrolled in your company's insurance, and that you want to check whether separate insurance procedures are required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保険のご相談は専門の窓口につなぎます。まず住所を確かめてから、こちらに戻っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will refer your insurance inquiry to the specialist counter. Could you first confirm the address and then come back here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大家さんへの電話を済ませて、この窓口に戻ります。保険の相談先も紙に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大家への電話後に同じ窓口へ戻ると約束し、保険の相談先の書面を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will finish the call to my landlord and return to this counter. Could you also write down where I should ask about insurance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return to the same counter after calling your landlord, and ask for the insurance inquiry contact in writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談先をこちらに記します。確認中の封筒はそのまま保管してください。それでは、いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will write the contact here. Please keep the envelope as it is while you are checking about it. Please excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約のことでお困りだと伺いました。看護師の私でよければ、まずご事情をお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you are having trouble with an appointment. If you are happy to speak to me as a nurse, I can first listen to your situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週火曜の九時に予約がありますが、勤務が変わって行けません。午後への変更を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来週火曜九時の予約と勤務変更を伝え、午後への変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an appointment at nine next Tuesday, but my work schedule has changed and I cannot attend. I would like to ask about moving it to the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your appointment is at nine next Tuesday and your work schedule has changed. Ask about changing it to the afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更の手配は受付が担当します。今の体調に変わりはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Reception handles appointment changes. Has there been any change in how you are feeling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前回の診察から特に変わっていません。ただ、受診を遅らせてよいかは自分では判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 体調変化はないと答えつつ、受診延期の可否は判断できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There has been no particular change since my last consultation. But I cannot judge for myself whether it is all right to delay the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your condition has not changed, but you cannot decide for yourself whether postponing the consultation is appropriate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その点は医師へ確認が必要ですね。予約票を拝見して、担当の診療科におつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will need to check that with the doctor. I will look at your appointment slip and put you in touch with the department responsible for your care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この予約票です。同じ週の木曜なら仕事を休めますので、その希望も伝えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約票を示し、同じ週の木曜は休めるという希望の伝達を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is my appointment slip. I could take time off work on Thursday of the same week. Could you pass on that preference too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your appointment slip and ask in Japanese for your availability on Thursday of the same week to be passed on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 木曜をご希望と伝えます。今ここで新しい日時を確約はできませんが、受付で空きを確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell them you would prefer Thursday. I cannot confirm a new date and time here, but reception can check for available appointments.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、まだ火曜の予約は取り消さずに、木曜の空きと医師の確認結果を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 木曜の空きと医師の確認結果を聞くまで元の予約を取り消さないよう求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I would like to keep my Tuesday appointment for now and decide after hearing about Thursday's availability and the doctor's answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the original appointment to be kept until you hear about availability on Thursday and the doctor's answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先に取り消さないご希望も引き継ぎます。受付は右の相談カウンターです。案内票にはお名前をどう記載しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also pass on your request not to cancel the original appointment first. Reception is at the consultation counter on the right. How should I write your name on the referral slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約票と同じ「グエン・アン」でお願いします。この案内票と予約票を持って、右のカウンターに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約票と同じ氏名で案内票を頼み、二枚の票を持って右の受付へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please use Nguyen An, as on my appointment slip. I will take this referral slip and my appointment slip to the counter on the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the referral slip to use the same name as your appointment slip. Say you will take both slips to reception on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: グエン・アン様ですね。お渡しする案内票にご希望を記しました。受付でご相談ください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nguyen An, understood. I have written your requests on the referral slip I am giving you. Please discuss them with reception. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車がなくなったとのことですが、最後に見た時と、なくなったと気付いた時を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You said your bicycle is missing. Please tell me when you last saw it and when you noticed it was gone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜八時に店の裏の駐輪場に置き、今朝七時に戻ったらありませんでした。場所を間違えた可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜八時と今朝七時の状況、場所の取り違えの可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left it in the bicycle parking area behind the store at eight last night. When I returned at seven this morning, it was not there. I may have mixed up the location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese the situation at eight last night and seven this morning, and explain that you may have confused the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その間のことはまだ分からないのですね。駐輪場の管理者には確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you do not yet know what happened in between. Have you checked with the manager of the bicycle parking area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店がまだ開いていなくて、確認できていません。入口に移動先の案内があったかも、もう一度見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店が開いておらず管理者へ未確認と説明し、移動先の掲示を見直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The store is not open yet, so I have not been able to check. I will also look again to see whether there was a notice at the entrance saying where bicycles had been moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not checked with the manager because the store is not open, and that you will look again for a notice about where bicycles were moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できたことと、まだ分からないことを分けて伺います。自転車の色や目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will keep what you have confirmed separate from what is still unknown. What color is the bicycle, and does it have any identifying features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、後ろのかごに青いひもを結んでいます。車体を写した写真と、防犯登録の控えがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀色と青いひもの特徴を伝え、写真と防犯登録の控えがあると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is silver, with a blue string tied to the rear basket. I have a photograph of the bicycle and a copy of its anti-theft registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the silver bicycle and blue string in Japanese, and say that you have a photograph and a copy of the anti-theft registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その写真と控えを見せてください。鍵の状態は、最後に見た時どうでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me the photograph and registration copy. What was the state of the locks when you last saw it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後輪の鍵をかけたのは覚えていますが、別のワイヤー錠を使ったかは思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後輪の施錠は覚えているがワイヤー錠の使用は不確かと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember locking the rear wheel, but I cannot remember whether I used the separate cable lock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you remember locking the rear wheel, but are unsure whether you used the cable lock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 覚えていない部分はそのままで結構です。店に確認した結果は、こちらへお知らせいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can leave the parts you do not remember as uncertain. Could you let us know the result after checking with the store?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理者に移動の有無を聞いて、結果を連絡します。その時のために、この相談窓口の連絡先を控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理者への確認結果を連絡すると伝え、相談窓口の連絡先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the manager whether it was moved and let you know the result. I would like to note this office's contact details so I can do that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report the result of checking with the manager, and ask for this office's contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先の紙をお渡しします。確認結果を伺ってから、必要な届け出をご案内します。道中、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will give you a sheet with the contact details. After hearing what you find out, we will explain any reports you need to make. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お預かりする前に、宛先と、希望される送り方をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before we accept the item, please tell me the destination and how you would like to send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この申込先へ書類を送ります。送った後に、届いたか自分で調べられる方法にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申込書類の送付先を示し、配達状況を自分で調べられる方法を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending documents to this organization for an application. I would like a method that lets me check for myself afterward whether they have arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show where you are sending the application documents, and ask in Japanese for a method that lets you check their delivery status yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追跡できる方法をご案内できます。提出先から送り方の指定はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can explain methods with tracking. Has the organization receiving the documents specified a shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には「発送した記録を保管」とあります。これは相手の受取印が必要という意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送記録を保管という指示を読み、受取印まで必要なのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions say to keep a record of dispatch. Does that mean I need the recipient's stamp as well?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the instruction to keep a record of dispatch and ask in Japanese whether a recipient's stamp is also required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その文章だけでは、受取印まで必要か判断できません。受け付けた記録と、受取人の確認は別の点です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That wording alone does not tell us whether a recipient's stamp is required. A record that the item was accepted for posting and confirmation from the recipient are separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要な記録を取り違えたくないので、提出先に確認します。それまでは封筒を預けずに持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先へ条件を確認すると決め、未発送の封筒を持ち帰れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not want to confuse the required records, so I will check with the organization receiving the documents. Until then, may I take the envelope home without leaving it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the requirements with the recipient, and ask whether you may take the unsent envelope home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、お持ち帰りいただけます。宛名の書き方で気になる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so you may take it home. Is there anything about how to write the address that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部署名まで書きましたが、担当者名は知りません。案内の宛先と照らして、抜けがないか見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当者名が不明で部署名まで記載したと説明し、案内との照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have written the department name, but I do not know the contact person's name. Could you compare it with the address in the instructions and check whether anything is missing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have written the department name but do not know the contact person's name. Ask for it to be checked against the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内どおり部署名まで記載されていますね。担当者名が別に必要かも、提出先に確認されるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You have included the department name as the instructions specify. It would also be a good idea to ask the recipient whether a contact person's name is additionally required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 送り方と担当者名の必要性を確認してから出しに来ます。原本は入っていますが、先に手元用のコピーも取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送り方と担当者名を確認後に再来すると伝え、原本の手元用コピーも取ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will come back to send it after checking the shipping method and whether a contact person's name is needed. The originals are inside, but I will first make copies to keep myself as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return after checking the shipping method and need for a contact person's name, and that you will also make copies of the originals for your own records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、封筒と案内をお返しします。確認後に希望の条件をお知らせください。お気をつけてお帰りくださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will return your envelope and the instructions. Please tell us your required conditions after checking. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設の事前相談ですね。主にどのようなお取引を予定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about opening an account in advance, correct? What kinds of transactions do you mainly plan to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今月から働く会社の給与受け取り用です。会社の用紙にこの銀行の名前があったので相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受取用と説明し、会社用紙に銀行名があったため来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is for receiving my salary from the company I start working for this month. This bank's name was on the company's form, so I came to ask about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the account is for receiving your salary and that you came because the company's form named this bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 指定なのか例なのかで確認が必要ですね。その用紙と、お名前を確認できるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check whether that is a requirement or just an example. Do you have that form and something that confirms your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用紙と在留カードがあります。会社の用紙では名前が途中で省略されていますが、カードには全部載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社用紙と在留カードを示し、氏名の省略と正式表記の差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the form and my residence card. My name is shortened partway through on the company's form, but it is written in full on my card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the company form and residence card. Explain in Japanese the difference between the shortened name and the full official spelling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 省略のある名前をそのまま申込書へ写さず、まず正式な表記を確認しましょう。会社にも用紙の記載について聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not copy the shortened name straight onto the application form. Let's first check the full official spelling. Can you also ask your company about the name on its form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者に確認できます。この銀行の口座が必須なのか、名前をどう直すのか、二つ聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当者へ銀行指定の有無と氏名修正の二点を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can check with the person responsible. I will ask both whether I must use an account at this bank and how to correct my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask the person responsible two things: whether this bank is required and how to correct your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認後に申込方法をご案内します。お勤め先から、口座番号を出す期限は言われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After you have checked, we will explain how to apply. Has your employer given you a deadline for submitting an account number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金曜までと言われています。ただ、今日ここで開設できるとは限らないことを会社に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口座番号提出期限が金曜と答え、即日開設できるとは限らないことを会社へ伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: They said by Friday. But I would like to tell my company that I may not be able to open the account here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the deadline for submitting your account number is Friday and that you want to tell your company same-day account opening is not guaranteed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、書類の確認や審査を経るため、開設や完了日はお約束できません。今日の相談内容を書き留めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Because we need to check documents and conduct a review, we cannot promise that an account will be opened or give a completion date. Would you like to make a note of today's discussion?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行名の指定と氏名の修正を会社に確認し、回答を持って再相談する、とメモします。申込書はまだ出さずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社回答を持って再相談する順序をメモし、申込書はまだ提出しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note that I need to ask my company whether this bank is required and how to correct my name, then come back to discuss it with their answer. I will not submit the application form yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note the steps for returning with your company's answer and will hold off submitting the application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順序で承ります。会社からの回答がありましたら、窓口で改めてご相談ください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will proceed in that order. Once your company has replied, please come back to the counter to discuss it. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その棚の商品でしょうか。お探しの容量を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a product on that shelf? Could you tell me which size you are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 洗剤の六百ミリリットルを探しています。二百九十八円の札の上にある、この袋で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六百ミリリットル希望と二百九十八円の札を示し、持った袋との対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for the six-hundred-milliliter detergent. Is this bag above the 298-yen price label the right one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want 600 mL, point out the 298-yen label, and ask whether it corresponds to the bag you are holding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その札は六百ミリリットル用ですが、お持ちの袋は九百ミリリットルです。六百はこちらの小さい袋です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That label is for 600 mL, but the bag you are holding is 900 mL. This smaller bag is the 600 mL size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい方にします。この「二点で五百円」は、同じ香りを二つ買う場合だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六百の袋を選び、二点五百円の割引で同じ香りが必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will take the smaller one. Does this two-for-500-yen offer apply only if I buy two with the same scent?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the 600 mL bag and ask in Japanese whether the two-for-500-yen offer requires both to have the same scent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この札では、同じシリーズの六百ミリリットルなら香りを組み合わせられます。九百は対象外で、会員登録は不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to this label, you can combine different scents of the 600 mL products in the same series. The 900 mL size is excluded, and you do not need to register as a member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 無香料と花の香りを一袋ずつにすると、会員でなくても税込五百円ということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二種の香り各一袋でも非会員の税込合計が五百円か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So if I buy one unscented bag and one floral-scented bag, the total is 500 yen including tax even if I am not a member, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that one bag of each of two scents costs a total of 500 yen including tax for a nonmember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらは税込表示です。ただ、この二つはどちらも詰め替え用です。専用の本体ボトルはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, the displayed price includes tax. However, both of these are refill pouches. Do you have the original bottle designed for this product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 引っ越したばかりで本体はありません。詰め替え用二袋はやめて、ポンプ付きの本体を一つ買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本体未所持と説明し、詰め替え二袋を取りやめポンプ付き本体一つへ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have just moved and do not have the original bottle. I will not take the two refill pouches; I would like one original bottle with a pump instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not have the original bottle and want to change from two refill pouches to one original bottle with a pump.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本体はこちらで、税込三百八十円です。先ほどの二点の割引には入りません。香りはどうされますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋は私がお戻しします。本体はこちらをレジにお持ちください。またのご来店をお待ちしております。
